_comment: Round 07 - FIVE quadrupedal war hounds, one design line, five colourways. Built on r04_02 (the only keeper of round 04): the user called its silhouette good and wants it as the basis of a new round. Three fixes requested: (1) the right-arm weapon was ambiguous - now every unit carries a NAMED weapon whose parts are spelled out, so it reads as a weapon and not a slab; (2) the shoulders were random spikes - now a defined pauldron assembly with two stacked plates, a recessed circular housing, a top ridge and a hard shoulder cap; (3) the set had no colour variety - the LIVERY STRUCTURE is shared in styleSuffix (one dominant colour over a dark structural colour with one worn accent) and only the HUES vary per unit. The art style itself stays locked exactly as in round 06, because that is the part that was wrong before.
_styleNote: Colourway varies per unit ON PURPOSE - the user asked for it. The lock is on the art style, the construction language, the camera and the lighting, not on the palette.
promptPrefix: A single full-body hero concept-art portrait of a quadrupedal armoured war hound,
styleSuffix: . A heavy four-legged war machine built to run down infantry: a long armoured spine carried low and held horizontal on four powerful digitigrade legs, a heavy sloped head with a single wide visor band and a pair of short tusk-like armour spurs at the cheeks, and a row of weapon pods and missile racks mounted along the spine. Every machine in this set is built to one identical design standard, so the set reads as one production line: the same square bevelled shoulder pauldrons on every unit, each built from two stacked plates with a recessed circular housing on the outer face and a raised ridge running along the top edge, and a hard shoulder cap over the joint; the same wide low head module with a single visor band; the same thick digitigrade legs ending in broad clawed feet; chunky exposed hydraulic actuators and cable looms along the flanks; matte ceramic composite plating over a dark structural frame; and a livery built on the same three-colour structure on every unit, one dominant armour colour over a dark structural colour with a single worn accent colour, plus a small set of painted chevron hazard stripes on the outer legs that read as plain geometric shapes and never as characters. Heavy visible panel seams, thick structural ribs and recessed bolt heads, chipped paint showing bare steel, scorch marks and paint burns, dust and grit caked into the lower legs. Every machine shows the same light even field wear: a uniform chalky grey dust film on the upward-facing surfaces, faint scuffs on the leading edges, dried mud caked into the leg joints. Shot identically on every machine: a low three-quarter front view from the left, camera at the height of the machine's hull, a 50mm lens, the whole machine in frame with clear air around it. Standing on a seamless neutral silver-grey studio backdrop with a soft contact shadow under its feet. The backdrop is plain and empty: no landscape, no sky, no horizon, no ground scenery, no buildings, no props, no weapons on the ground, no rubble. Nothing else in the frame except the machine and its shadow. Military concept art in a painterly semi-realistic real-robot mecha illustration style, smooth airbrushed gradients, soft volumetric haze, gentle film grain, studio key light high above and slightly to the left, falling on the machine only, cool soft fill on the camera-facing side, a bright thin edge highlight running down the left side of the machine, flat even overhead ambient lighting on the floor, the floor a matte plane of one uniform neutral grey with no horizontal gradient across it, all the way to every edge of the frame, with no directional falloff, no pool of light, no bright corner, no dark corner and no reflection. Huge readable silhouette, crisp negative space between the limbs, fine mechanical detail, deep contact shadows. No text, no lettering, no watermark, no scenery, no extra limbs, no duplicated parts.

backdropDesc: seamless neutral silver-grey studio backdrop, plain and empty, smooth vertical gradient from light grey at the top to mid grey at the floor, soft contact shadow pooled under the subject, one uniform matte neutral grey with no horizontal gradient across the floor, evenly lit across the whole frame with no pool of light and no bright corner, no landscape, no sky, no horizon, no scenery, no buildings, no props
